overview: MediVault is a feature-complete healthcare operations platform with guided walkthroughs, demo reset, and showcase-ready presentation modes for all five clinical roles.
features: Demo Reset button in Admin dashboard to restore clean demo state
Hospital role guided 6-step walkthrough (consent, adherence, diagnostics, reporting, audit)
Lab role guided 5-step walkthrough (report upload, diagnostics, audit trail, ecosystem)
Showcase stability — walkthroughs never block navigation, always dismissible/restartable
Realistic demo data across all dashboards with believable medicine names and operational states
Presentation mode toggle for projector and large-display readability
